reviews.title: Working great with XMP on.
reviews.comment: Installed with Intel 14 Gen throttling enabled and xmp memory enabled. No hiccups or issues 5 months in
reviews.author: Aefisch

reviews.title: Does what it is supposed to.
reviews.comment: This ram runs at 6000mhz. The people having issues probably did not enable the correct settings on their bios to allow it to run at 6000mhz.
reviews.author: John clark

reviews.title: Works great, No issues
reviews.comment: As advertised. Works great in my rig. Easy to install
reviews.author: S. Gentry

reviews.title: Crashed when I turned on xmp and went 6000mhz then when on auto it sets to this.
reviews.comment: Received ram that would only go 3600Mhz I ordered 6000 not 3600 wildly false advertising. Package even said 6000mhz on the box but it was a lie.
reviews.author: Rob Yamato
